title: Source critique with a missing evidence requirement
assignment: Write a short evidence-informed position on AI feedback. generative AI may assist search terms and draft summaries. Students must verify sources and evaluate whether claims match the evidence.
ai_permissions: Write a short evidence-informed position on AI feedback. generative AI may assist search terms and draft summaries. Students must verify sources and evaluate whether claims match the evidence.
budget_scope: Additional checkpoint work; existing product marking excluded

requirements.description: Distinguish claim from inference in a supplied excerpt.
independently corroborate or challenge a claim using a second source not supplied in the task. Each requires one individual demonstration.

checkpoints.name: Claim and inference annotation
checkpoints.prompt: A and C use an teacher-supplied excerpt and ask students to mark evidence and inference. No activity asks students to locate and inspect an independent second source. This omission is intentional. Candidate: Claim and inference annotation.
checkpoints.conditions: E1 Distinguish claim from inference in a supplied excerpt. E2 judge a source limitation. E3 independently corroborate or challenge a claim using a second source not supplied in the task. Each requires one individual demonstration.
checkpoints.ai_permissions: Write a short evidence-informed position on AI feedback. generative AI may assist search terms and draft summaries. Students must verify sources and evaluate whether claims match the evidence.
checkpoints.mapping_rationale: A bibliography or available hyperlink does not establish corroboration. Approve G only if its prompt and scoring require inspection of the source and a reasoned support judgment.

approval.reviewer: Original development fixture; expert review pending

expected_narrative: No complete plan exists, even when the teacher time limit is removed. E3 has zero eligible candidates. Increasing time cannot repair the missing mapping. In a separate repair variant, add G, a supervised second-source verification activity: P = 15, R = 2, N = 30, L = 20, S = 20; cost 95 and coverage E3. Then C + G is the cheapest complete combination at 170 minutes and S = 35.
